name: sprite_builder_get_codespace
description: Get a codespace by id and check its status. Lifecycle: queued -> provisioning -> ready | failed. All file/exec/git/clone ops require status 'ready'; otherwise they 400. Poll this after creating one.

codespace_id.description: The codespace's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_codespace / sprite_builder_list_codespaces).
